note: Seed SLOs. Values with source "4.15" are given by the master prompt; others cite their section or are marked ASSUMPTION and are replaced by the 28-day control limits once 14 days of real data exist. facts alignment: supabase/migrations/2026*_smc_04_facts.sql did not exist when this was written, so every "source.status" is crm-gap (table/column named in build/crm-gap.md) or proposed (name not yet in any migration; platform-architect to confirm or provide a view with the same name).

rules.min_evidence_note: Per metric, only the keys listed under min_evidence apply (all must be met). The gate stops the advisor from PROPOSING; it never hides a reading. It is waived when an SLO is burning (burn > 2x) and for zero_tolerance compliance controls. Section 3.4 kill/scale rules are deterministic rules (ops.proposals.source = kill_rule) and run from R3,000 spend as written; they are not advisor proposals.
rules.tiers: headline metrics may raise "Not working" on one out-of-limit day; input metrics need two consecutive out-of-limit days (detectConfirmed) or a 7-point run, and otherwise stay in the faculty drill-down.
